description: This file is a GPIO driver implementation for Atmel SAM4L microcontrollers, providing functions to configure GPIO pins, including setting attributes, input filters, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: configure_common_attr
methods.description: Configures common GPIO attributes such as pull-up, pull-down, open drain, and interrupt disable.

methods.name: configure_input_attr
methods.description: Configures input filter and interrupt settings for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: soc_gpio_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin based on provided settings, including function selection and peripheral enabling.

methods.name: soc_gpio_list_configure
methods.description: Configures a list of GPIO pins.
